There is no axis, ruler, filled band or selected interval to aim for. The instruction is repeat when well and, if still raised, review overall heart risk.

The EN reader still felt below2 might be preferable; no universal healthy goal was stated. Timing/context questions remain clinical, not a reason to invent a personalized interval.

Named comparison groups, updated screen-reader description, semantic caption join, keyboard/details/focus, free-upload intent and reduced-motion content pass.
